question: Which ministry has launched "Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana" in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Communications**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana** (Scholarship for Promotion of Aptitude & Research in Stamps as a Hobby) was launched by the **Ministry of Communications** in August 2017, with the aim to promote philately as a hobby among school students.

• The scheme provides a **scholarship** to students of classes VI to IX who display a strong inclination towards philately, which is the study and collection of postage stamps.

• The scholarship is awarded to students who score **60% or more marks** in their previous final examination and pass a philately quiz and project conducted by the postal department.

• The scheme also aims to develop a **scientific temperament** and a spirit of inquiry among students through the hobby of philately.

• Under this scheme, **40 scholarships** are awarded per postal circle, and each scholarship carries a monetary award of **Rs. 6,000 annually** (Rs. 500 per month).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Philately**: 

• Philately refers to the **study and collection of postage stamps and postal history**.

• It is considered an important educational and historical hobby, helping students understand the culture, history, and heritage of their country and the world.

• Philately is often referred to as the “**king of hobbies**” due to its wide appeal and historical significance.

• **Ministry of Communications**:

• The **Ministry of Communications** is responsible for the functioning of **India Post**, which oversees postal services in the country.

• The ministry includes two key departments: **Department of Posts** and **Department of Telecommunications**.

• The **Department of Posts** manages initiatives like philately and other schemes aimed at leveraging postal services for education and awareness.

• **Criteria for Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana**:

• The scheme is open to students of classes VI to IX in recognized schools across India.

• Participants are required to have their own philately deposit account and submit a project on a philately-related topic.

• Students must pass a **philately quiz** and a **philatelic project** evaluation conducted by the postal circle.

• **Promotion of Philately**:

• India Post organizes various philately exhibitions, workshops, and competitions to promote this hobby among school students.

• Philately clubs are also being established in schools to encourage participation in stamp collection and related activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Other Initiatives by India Post:**

• India Post organizes **National Philatelic Exhibitions** to showcase rare and unique stamps.

• Special initiatives like **My Stamp** allow individuals to create personalized stamps with their own photographs.

• **India Post's Role in Education:**

• The postal department actively contributes to promoting **education and awareness** through schemes like Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana.

• It also runs initiatives for financial literacy and digital inclusion in rural areas.

• **Global Importance of Philately:**

• Many countries use philately as a medium to promote tourism, culture, and history.

• International philatelic exhibitions are held worldwide, fostering cultural exchange and historical preservation.

5c
